# API contracts: Audit log and integrity

Each endpoint in the spec 29.5 template. Shared rules (errors, idempotency, versions, versioning): [API contracts guide](../README.md). Index: [all endpoints](README.md).

### GET /api/v1/audit-events/

| Field | Contract |
|---|---|
| Endpoint ID | `audit_events_list` |
| Method and path | `GET /api/v1/audit-events/` |
| Business purpose | List (audit events). Audit search for auditors. Searching and exporting the audit log are themselves audited. |
| Requirements | [HIMS-AUD-001](../../../requirements/audit-and-security.md#hims-aud-001), [HIMS-AUD-003](../../../requirements/audit-and-security.md#hims-aud-003) |
| Actor / permission required | `audit.view` (Search the audit log). System roles holding it: Auditor / compliance officer, Compliance / security officer. Privileged roles must have passed two-factor in this session |
| Customer / facility scope | Whole hospital: the grant must cover the whole organization |
| Request schema | No body; query: `action`, `actor_id`, `category`, `date_from`, `date_to`, `facility_id`, `occurred_after`, `occurred_before`, `outcome`, `page`, `page_size`, `person`, `request_id`, `resource_id`, `resource_type` |
| Response schema | 200 `PaginatedAuditEventList` |
| Validation rules | Query values outside the allowed ones are refused (400) or ignored |
| Allowed current states | Any |
| Resulting state | Unchanged (read only) |
| Idempotency key behavior | Not applicable (read only) |
| Concurrency control | None needed (read only) |
| Database transaction | Read only; the audit event of the read is saved in its own transaction |
| Audit event | `audit.events.searched` |
| Outbox / domain event | None |
| External calls | None |
| Timeout and retry policy | No outside calls inside the request |
| Expected error codes | 401 `NOT_AUTHENTICATED`, 403 `MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED`, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, 429 `RATE_LIMITED` |
| Rate / volume assumptions | not signed in: 60/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_ANON`); signed in: 1200/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_USER`); pages of 25 (`page_size` up to 100) |
| Metrics and alerts | Request log line and trace span with `request_id`, status and time; response-time targets checked by the volume check (HIMS-OPS-017); hosted alarms with HIMS-OPS-004 |
| Automated test cases | `apps/audit/tests/test_audit.py::test_audit_search_requires_audit_permission`, `apps/audit/tests/test_audit.py::test_auditor_can_search_and_search_is_audited`, `apps/audit/tests/test_audit_screen.py::test_list_shows_who_where_and_what`, `apps/audit/tests/test_audit_screen.py::test_find_by_reference_person_category_and_day`, `apps/audit/tests/test_audit_screen.py::test_bad_filters_give_a_clear_message_not_a_server_error`, `apps/audit/tests/test_audit_screen.py::test_only_auditors_can_search`, `apps/audit/tests/test_audit_screen.py::test_searching_is_itself_audited`, `apps/audit/tests/test_audit_screen.py::test_export_csv_is_safe_limited_and_audited` and 4 more |

### POST /api/v1/audit-integrity-checks/

| Field | Contract |
|---|---|
| Endpoint ID | `audit_integrity_checks_create` |
| Method and path | `POST /api/v1/audit-integrity-checks/` |
| Business purpose | Add (audit integrity checks). Seal new events and check the whole chain now. Takes a few seconds. |
| Requirements | [HIMS-SEC-010](../../../requirements/audit-and-security.md#hims-sec-010) |
| Actor / permission required | `audit.view` (Search the audit log). System roles holding it: Auditor / compliance officer, Compliance / security officer. Privileged roles must have passed two-factor in this session |
| Customer / facility scope | Whole hospital: the grant must cover the whole organization |
| Request schema | No body |
| Response schema | 201 `AuditIntegrityCheckDetail` |
| Validation rules | Fields as in the request schema; anything invalid is 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` with each field's problem, and nothing is saved |
| Allowed current states | Any (no state rule) |
| Resulting state | As in the purpose above; the new state is in the response and the audit event |
| Idempotency key behavior | Not taken: repeating the request is refused by the state rules or is harmless |
| Concurrency control | No version check (adds a new record or is a one-off action); unique rules in the database refuse duplicates |
| Database transaction | One transaction: the change, its audit event and any background event are saved together or not at all |
| Audit event | `audit.integrity.alert_sent`, `audit.integrity.checked` |
| Outbox / domain event | None |
| External calls | Messages (email; SMS printed on the console until a gateway is chosen): tried at once and logged; a failure never undoes the action |
| Timeout and retry policy | messages: email timeout 20 s; a failed message is retried every few minutes with a growing pause, up to 5 tries, then shows as failed with Send again; the client should reload before retrying a lost answer |
| Expected error codes | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, 401 `NOT_AUTHENTICATED`, 403 `MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED`, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, 409 `CHECK_RUNNING`, 409 `CONFLICT`, 429 `RATE_LIMITED` |
| Rate / volume assumptions | not signed in: 60/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_ANON`); signed in: 1200/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_USER`) |
| Metrics and alerts | Request log line and trace span with `request_id`, status and time; response-time targets checked by the volume check (HIMS-OPS-017); hosted alarms with HIMS-OPS-004 |
| Automated test cases | `apps/audit/tests/test_integrity.py::test_auditor_checks_now_and_sees_history`, `apps/audit/tests/test_integrity.py::test_administrators_cannot_see_or_run_checks` |
| Backward-compatibility policy | API v1 rules in [the API contracts guide](../README.md#versioning-and-breaking-changes); CI fails when `docs/api/openapi.yaml` differs from the code |
